en: Black‑and‑white view of a central European town square with historic multi‑storey buildings around an open cobblestone plaza. Shopfronts on the ground floors have German signage. Visible signs include a hotel called "Hôtel Goldener Löwe", a Singer Co. sewing‑machine store, a business named K. Pfertstein, and another marked "Seifen‑Fabrik von Wilh. Giessmann". In the middle of the square stands an ornate lamppost or fountain. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn carriage move across the largely empty square, and one person in the foreground wears a uniform or traditional dress.
